summary: SMIv2 is the language for MIB modules used with SNMP, and YANG is the data modeling language used with NETCONF. This RFC defines how to translate SMIv2 MIB modules into YANG modules.

eli5.summary: Two groups write their rules in different languages. This is a guide for translating the old one into the new one.
